transcript:
Meeting header:
Date: 2026-03-09
Start: 15:32 PST
Duration: ~43 mins
Attendees: Jordan Hale (Redwood AE); Maya Chen (Redwood SE); Priya Rao (Redwood CSM); Tom Adler (AzureWay Procurement); Leila Ortiz (AzureWay Legal); Marcus Yeo (AzureWay Sec); Sana Begum (AzureWay IT)

Summary: quick procurement + legal review of MSA/DPA and SLAs, clarifying liability cap, data residency, encryption/KMS, onboarding steps, and pricing approvals. Action items and next steps agreed — redlines, SOC2, and final PO timeline.

Transcript:
[00:00] Jordan: hey everyone, thanks for joining, i'll hand over to maya to do a quick agenda but we'll focus on the MSA and DPA items that Leila flagged and rundowns on slas and pricing approvals, okay?
[00:08] Maya: yeah hi all, uh quick agenda, 1) legal redlines 2) security controls 3) sla and uptime / liability 4) pricing - procurement signal and PO timeline 5) onboarding next steps. if we can get through the main asks that'll be great.
[00:22] Tom: sounds good. just to say, procurement is on a tight timeline, our vendor board meets next tuesday so if we can have near-final docs before then that's ideal.
[00:31] Leila: yeah and from legal we already sent a first pass of redlines. main items are indemnity, liability cap, data processing definitions in the DPA, breach notification timing and subprocessor flow-downs.
[00:41] Jordan: got it. when you said vendor board next tuesday, that's the 17th?
[00:45] Tom: yes, the 17th, so ideally we want an internal signoff + PO by the 20th.
[00:50] Maya: note, our standard sla for hosted plans is 99.9% with credits; for Dedicated customers we can discuss higher SLAs and SLOs; also private deployments have different support and pricing.
[00:58] Marcus: a couple of security questions — we need to confirm KMS options, whether we can bring our own key, and if HSM support is available for private deployments. and also network egress diagrams for the VPC connector.
[01:12] Maya: yes on BYOK, we support customer-managed keys via KMS for our Private offering; for hosted we provide an option to integrate with customer KMS via a secure key-wrapping flow, i'll send the architecture note. about HSM, we integrate with common HSMs for on-prem or private.
[01:28] Leila: on the DPA, can we clarify the data categories — we want to ensure PII and operational logs are covered, and limitations on retention beyond 90 days unless specified. also DPA requires 30 day notice for subprocessor changes.
[01:40] Jordan: that aligns with our typical language; we can accept 90-day default for session logs, and retention adjustments by request, we'll flag that to the legal team.
[01:48] Leila: liability cap: AzureWay needs a carve-out for gross negligence and will push for a cap at 3x fees or $5M, whichever lower. your standard is often aggregate cap equal to fees paid in 12 months.
[02:02] Jordan: okay noted. we can share the rationale for the 12-month fees cap, but we'll also escalate if you need a higher negotiated cap for enterprise contracts.
[02:10] Tom: procurement also want to confirm billing terms — net 45 is our standard, can you do net 45? and we need an initial PO for the pilot scope, which is small but needs to be in place.
[02:20] Priya: we generally do net 30 by default, enterprise can get net 45 on contract; i'll flag finance to confirm. for the pilot we can accept a PO and invoice schedule to match your internal cadence.
[02:30] Sana: operational question — for onboarding, do you have a managed onboarding option or is it self-serve? and will we have a dedicated customer success contact?
[02:38] Priya: yes, we provide a CSM-led onboarding for enterprise customers, includes two 90-minute sessions and an optional benchmarking run. i'm listed as your initial CSM.
[02:46] Marcus: can you run a benchmark with our sample payload? want to capture latency numbers and cost per token for our 8k seq use case.
[02:53] Maya: absolutely, we can run a bench on our Dedicated tier or Hosted depending on availability; we'll need a sample prompt set and traffic profile — i'll send a template. results typically take 3-5 business days to produce.
[03:04] Leila: also, regarding the DPA, can you confirm breach notification window? our policy expects 72 hours for incidents impacting personal data.
[03:12] Jordan: our standard is 72 hours, yes; we'll make that explicit in the DPA.
[03:16] Leila: okay good. one more thing — can you confirm SOC 2 Type II and ISO attestation? we need to attach reports to the vendor pack.
[03:24] Maya: we have SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 — i'll share redacted reports and the audit contact.
[03:30] Tom: regarding cost, finance will need the committed pricing for Dedicated versus our expected throughput. we have a sense of monthly tokens — roughly 50M tokens / month — can you share indicative pricing and any reserved capacity discounts?
[03:42] Jordan: we can provide a pricing sheet. typical hosted rates are pay-as-you-go; Dedicated offers committed discounts and predictable throughput. we'll attach a pricing tier sheet and example math for 50M tokens.
[03:52] Tom: does that include data retention costs? we need to know long-term storage pricing for logs or for audit traces.
[03:58] Priya: long-term retention and log storage can be added as an add-on; we'll include estimated costs in the pricing doc.
[04:05] Leila: about subcontractors / subprocessors — can you confirm you flow down DPA obligations to third parties and provide a current subprocessor list?
[04:13] Maya: yes we have a subprocessor list and we require flow-down in our DPA; we'll provide the current list and a notification cadence for changes.
[04:20] Marcus: for network architecture, we need an egress diagram and whether you support private endpoints for our VPC peers.
[04:27] Maya: we support VPC peering and private endpoints for Private deployments; for hosted we offer a connector that sits in your VPC to route traffic privately. i'll include diagrams.
[04:36] Sana: do you support SAML + SCIM for SSO and provisioning?
[04:39] Jordan: yes, we support SAML and SCIM; onboarding includes SSO setup and RBAC configuration.
[04:44] Tom: timeline: if we can get docs by next friday the 12th, our legal will review redlines and we can present to vendor board on the 17th. is that workable?
[04:52] Jordan: reasonable. our action is to get you redline-ready MSA and DPA and the security bundle by the 12th.
[04:58] Leila: minor note — any changes to data residency controls need to be explicit; AzureWay stores data in-eu for EU customers, can you support region pinning?
[05:07] Maya: yes we support region pinning for Hosted for enterprise customers and of course Private deployments can be deployed in your region.
[05:14] Tom: ok let's talk next steps.
[05:16] Jordan: recap: we will 1) send redlines and summaries, 2) security reports and architecture diagrams, 3) pricing sheet with committed discounts and add-on costs, 4) template for benchmarks, 5) propose onboarding kickoff dates.
[05:28] Priya: and i'll be the onboarding lead post-signature. i'll include a proposed schedule for the two onboarding sessions and the benchmarking window.
[05:35] Marcus: action items for us — i'll compile the KMS/HSM requirements and send by the 15th; Sana will confirm the PO approval flows.
[05:44] Tom: procurement will aim to confirm PO by the 20th if the contract is acceptable.
[05:50] Leila: thanks everyone. we'll review the redlines when received.
[05:54] Jordan: thanks all, we'll follow up in email and update crm. bye.
[05:58] (call ends)
